messages:
alex: Hey team — pushed an update to PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8342. I addressed the allocator edge-case we discussed, added a focused unit test, and removed the accidental debug log. PTAL when you have a minute.
priya: Thanks — I can review right after standup. Quick Q: did you preserve the public rotate() signature? We still need compatibility for dedicated customers.
alex: Yep — public API unchanged. I added an internal flag and a small helper. Diff snippet:```
- allocator.rotate(state)
+ allocator.rotate(state, _allow_rotation=true)
```
sam: Skimmed the changes — looks reasonable. Can you squash the fixup commit into the original? CI is failing on lint otherwise.
alex: Squashed and force-pushed (branch: fix/allocator-8342). Triggered CI: https://ci.internal/redwood/8342/12 :arrows_clockwise:
ci-bot: Build #12 started — running lint + unit tests.
maria: Left one tiny naming nit about the enum (prefers RESTART vs REWIND). Not a blocker, but consistent naming helps. @priya any strong preference?
priya: Not strong. If it's a one-line rename I'm fine with it, but don't let it block the merge. Functionality looks good to me.
sam: +1 after squash and CI green.
alex: I applied the enum rename and updated the test. Pushed again.
ci-bot: Build #12 succeeded — all checks passed.
priya: LGTM, thanks for the quick turnaround.
maria: LGTM from me too.
alex: Thanks everyone — merging now and will roll canary for a couple hours. Will follow up in the changelog with the user-facing note. :tada:
